decision_conditions:
CONDITION: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than 28/11/2020, the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission, ref: P2017/2444/FUL. 

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description: Section 73 application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary condition 2 (Drawings) of Planning Permission Reference: P2020/3313/S73 dated 24/09/2021 for Section 73 application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary condition 2 (Drawings) and condition 11 (energy statement) of Planning Permission Reference: P2017/2444/FUL dated 28/11/2017 for The construction of 40 new dwelling units comprising 8 x 1B2P units, 3 x 2B3P units, 27 x 2B4P units, 2 x 3B5P units with associated amenity space and 41.8sqm ancillary use floorspace, provided in six new residential blocks ranging from 2 to 6 storeys in height, along with bicycle storage, improvements to the public realm, and the demolition of existing garages and storage units. Amendments include changes to the means and route of access to the ground floor flat in block A.
